requirements.statement: CC.EN is bit 0, RW, reset 0; setting EN enables the controller and clearing it initiates Controller Reset.
requirements.note: Only the handshake and selected preservation behavior are covered, not all reset effects.

requirements.statement: When EN is zero, the controller shall not process commands or post completion queue entries.
Controller Level Reset caused by clearing EN does not affect Admin Queue properties AQA, ASQ, or ACQ.
requirements.note: One opaque token represents the tuple of prevalidated Admin Queue properties.

requirements.statement: Admin Queue properties may only be modified while EN is zero.
RDY is set when ready after enable and cleared once ready for re-enable after EN is cleared; submission before readiness produces undefined results.
requirements.note: Untimed progress requires explicit weak fairness; timeout compliance excluded.

assumptions.statement: One controller, normal operation; cooperative host avoids undefined EN writes; no subsystem/controller shutdown, fatal errors, firmware activation or power events.
Start after reset completion; Admin properties are represented by InitialAdminConfig, not claimed to have a hardware reset encoding.
Finite opaque tokens encode valid Admin Queue configurations; field widths, addresses and queue depths are abstracted.

One in-flight abstract command, idle/submitted/processed phases; reset discards in-flight work; persistent ghost counters observe work events and enforce basic counting consistency. Command opcodes, transport and cancellation protocol are excluded.
MaxOperations caps total process events at 1, 2, or 3 for exploration; it is not a device limit. Enable/reset cycles can continue after the cap.
Weak fairness for ControllerReady and ControllerResetDone; no timing bound and no unconditional command-completion liveness.

exclusions: Full reset effects of sections 3.7.2 and 3.7.2.1
Queues, doorbells, transport state, payload and persistent-data guarantees
Shutdown exceptions, timeouts, namespace readiness and invalid-host behavior
screenshot_usage: Formatting inspiration only; screenshot counter properties and thresholds are not NVMe source evidence.
